formattedAddress: No. 13, Alley 2, Lane 112, Section 3, Xinglong Rd, Xingde Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text: The food here is great. Still quite crowded even at 3pm. Tried a variety of food including the xiao long bao and crispy red bean pancake. Very well made. The noodle soup is simple but delicious. Overall good food with simple service.

text.text: After queuing for 20 minutes, I was able to get in quite quickly. The ordering is done via a paper menu, and the sauces, ginger strips, etc., are self-served at a condiment bar, allowing you to decide on the portion sizes, which is quite flexible and nice. As for the food, the dumplings were served piping hot. They were very juicy, and while the flavor wasn't extraordinarily delicious, the price was definitely a winning factor. Since I was dining alone, I couldn't try too many dishes, but I found the hot and sour soup delicious. It was packed with ingredients, though it's worth noting that the pepper flavor was quite strong, giving it a bit of a spicy kick, which was quite tasty. I've attached the April 2025 menu for your reference.

text.text:
Many friends recommended this place to me, and it's definitely worth visiting. If you're looking for decent dumplings at a reasonable price, this is the place to go.

However, I was a bit disappointed with the shrimp dumplings, as they didn’t match my taste, and the cabbage was a bit too sweet for my liking.

Overall, I would recommend the original soup dumplings, the sweet and sour soup, and other dishes.
